reviews.text: This toner is as light as water. I poured it into a spray bottle to mist my face after washing. I’ve used toners for years to balance and soothe my skin, but this one doesn't provide absolute comfort. I have to wait for it to dry completely so I can hurry up and apply my serum or cream. It didn't cause any irritation, which is a plus, but it is definitely not the best toner I've tried
reviews.zh: 呢款爽膚水輕到好似水咁。我倒咗入噴樽，喺洗面之後用嚟噴面。我用咗爽膚水多年嚟平衡同舒緩皮膚，但呢款就唔能夠畀到我完全嘅舒適感。要等佢完全乾透先可以趕住搽精華或者面霜。佢冇造成任何刺激，呢一點係加分位，但絕對唔係我用過嘅爽膚水入面最好嘅一款。

reviews.text:
El SKIN1004 Madagascar
Centella Toning Toner es un tónico excelente
para quienes buscan calmar, hidratar y
mejorar la textura de su piel sin riesgo de
irritación. Su fórmula suave y efectiva lo
hace adecuado para uso diario y para todo
tipo de piel, especialmente las sensibles.
Definitivamente lo volveré a comprar y lo
recomiendo ampliamente
reviews.zh: SKIN1004 Madagascar Centella Toning Toner 係一款出色嘅爽膚水，適合想舒緩、保濕同改善膚質，但又想避免刺激嘅人。佢配方溫和又有效，適合日常使用，仲適合任何膚質，尤其係敏感肌。一定會再回購，強烈推薦畀大家。

reviews.text: Toner’s texture is very liquid like water. Therefore, it is lightweight, you won’t feel it on the skin. Moreover it absorbs well and doesn’t leave a stickiness in the face. However, I feel toner needs more time to see any effect or result. Great for acne and sensitive type of skin. It calms down the irritation and redness. It’s kinda hard to say about moisturising effects since it isn’t cream. Although it is a solid option. It has no fragrance what is a big plus. I would repurchase it after running out of toner.
reviews.zh: 爽膚水嘅質地好水感，基本上似水。所以佢好輕，搽上面幾乎感覺唔到。而且吸收得好，唔會喺塊面留低黏笠感。不過，我覺得呢款爽膚水需要更多時間先見到效果。對暗瘡同敏感肌嚟講係唔錯。佢可以舒緩刺激同泛紅。保濕效果方面比較難講，因為佢始終唔係面霜。雖然佢係一款穩陣嘅選擇。佢冇香料，呢一點係好大嘅加分位。用完之後我會再回購。

reviews.text:
already on my second bottle!! i have acne-prone, oily skin and this has helped with reduce redness and inflammation and overall texture of my skin :’)

I take a cotton round and gentle swipe it across my face then wait for the product to absorb before moving onto the next step of my routine! highly recommend 🫶🏼
reviews.zh:
已經用緊第二支！！我有暗瘡同油性肌，呢款幫到我減少泛紅同炎症，整體膚質都改善咗：'）

我會用化妝棉輕輕一抹過塊面，然後等佢吸收咗先用下一步嘅護膚品！強烈推薦 🫶🏼

reviews.text:
I think this is the base toner everyone should try. Like, it doesn’t have any seeming effects but it does moisturise, it does absorbs quickly, economic usage, it doesn’t smell like anything (although my sis said it has cintella aroma but I don’t feel any smell).
I’m rating this with 5 stars, because overall it’s good product
reviews.zh: 我覺得呢款係每個人都應該一試嘅基礎爽膚水。佢好似冇咩明顯效果，但佢真係有保濕，吸收得快，用量慳，仲要係冇乜味道（雖然我阿妹話有積雪草香味，但我自己就聞唔到）。我俾5星，因為整體嚟講係好產品。

reviews.text: Extremely soothing and hydrated my skin (oily acne prone), I never broke out while using the product and cleared my red spots over time. Never irritated my skin nor damaged my skin barrier. Absorbs extremely quick. would 100% repurchase
reviews.zh: 極度舒緩，保濕皮膚（油性暗瘡肌），用緊期間完全冇爆瘡，仲隨住時間過去清走咗紅印。從未刺激過我嘅皮膚，亦都冇損害皮膚屏障。吸收速度極快。100%會再回購。

reviews.text: Not the best toner I have ever had, texture looks like water, using 2 weeks but not see the results, so I’m not sure about this product
reviews.zh: 唔係我用過最好嘅爽膚水，質地睇落好似水咁，用咗兩個星期但未見到效果，所以對呢款產品有保留。

reviews.text:
I have been using the entire Madagascar Centella line for over a month now and I can confidently say that it has changed my skin for the better. My skin’s texture is smoother, brighter and I no longer get those painful cystic acne, sometimes 1 hormonal pimple a month during my period which is manageable.

1. I double cleanse using the oil cleanser and then the ampoule foam cleanser
2. Toner
3. Ampoule 
4. Soothing cream
5. Cream
6. Sun cream (during the day)

Same routine for night time except sun cream.
reviews.zh:
我用咗成個 Madagascar Centella 系列超過一個月，我可以肯定咁講，佢令到我嘅皮膚變好咗。皮膚質地更滑、更亮，我再冇生嗰啲痛楚嘅囊腫暗瘡，間中可能一個月嚟m嗰陣會生一粒荷爾蒙瘡，都仲可以接受。

1. 我會用油性清潔產品做第一次清潔，再用泡沫潔面乳做第二次清潔
2. 爽膚水
3. 安瓶
4. 舒緩面霜
5. 面霜
6. 防晒（日間）

夜晚嘅護膚程序一樣，只係唔用防晒。

note: 以下評價由 Olive Young 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
